# P10 Acceptance criteria and verification plan

- Requirement: Required for changes, bugs, removal, performance and handoffs. A short fact question may close with the answer required in P05
- Placement: The relevant discussion in the body
- Narrative role: Closes with what to verify and what to do next.
- Author: The side defining the required result and the side performing verification
- Reviewer: Both sides confirm shared results and conditions; the executor confirms the feasible scope
- Check: Are expected results observable? Have unagreed criteria been treated as pass conditions? Are plans separated from execution?

<!-- body:start -->
## Completion conditions and next steps

Use the following conditions to determine whether [requested result] has been obtained. These are [a verification plan or criteria reflecting executed results]. If source material does not establish whether execution occurred or what the results were, leave that scope unconfirmed. Mark an item not performed only when actual nonexecution is confirmed.

- Under [input, conditions and reference time], [observable expected result] must occur. [Owner] checks it using [method, level and environment]. Current status: [execution unconfirmed, result unconfirmed, not performed, failed, passed, or criteria under review].
- [Conditions actually to preserve, such as correctness, permissions or compatibility]. Delete this item if there are no additional criteria.

[Whether the executor and schedule have been accepted]. Leave [unchecked scope] with [next owner and confirmation conditions]. Once the required answers and verification are received, proceed with [next work or closure judgment]. For lists and aggregates whose data changes, first align the reference time for comparison.
